turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling now after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: I'm feeling a bit tired, but okay. Got some pain in the tummy area.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Can you rate the pain for me, from 0 to 10? And have you felt nauseous at all?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe a 4 or 5? And yeah, a little bit of nausea, but not too bad.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Alright, we can manage that pain and nausea for you. How’s your breathing? Any discomfort or difficulty breathing?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Breathing is fine, no problem. Throat is a bit sore though.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: That sore throat can happen from the LMA tube. It should ease soon. Any moments where you felt awake during the surgery or remember anything?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I don’t remember anything. Went to sleep and woke up here.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Good. Given your diabetes, kidney issues, and high blood pressure, we’ll keep a close eye on your vitals and fluid balance. Any other concerns?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: No, I think that’s all for now. Thanks for checking on me.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Of course. We’ll get you more comfortable and ready to move to the ward soon.
